verdict.rationale: LM Studio's core purpose is running LLMs on the user's machine. Its docs describe downloading and running local models, chatting with documents "entirely offline," and a server bound to localhost unless the user opts in to network access; voice data is stated to be processed locally and never leave the device. Community users independently confirm it works as a local model runtime. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party privacy/telemetry statement that chat prompts and data never leave the device (the never-leaves claim is documented only for voice), and independent verification of no outbound data.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Download and run local LLMs like gpt-oss or Llama, Qwen
You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline
Turning this on will open up the server to requests outside of 'localhost'.
Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
A local model runtime, a model catalog, a UI to chat with models easily
